name: Call of Blood
storyline:
2009. After killing an influential politician, the main character hides in an abandoned city, trying to survive in a world devastated by a zombie outbreak.

The politician was responsible for the creation of three dangerous reactors. His friends had helped uncover the truth behind a project that could have killed millions. After the assassination, the army, security forces, and an organization known as Wors — the High Special Services Response Node — began hunting him.

Scientists who had worked with him for years force him to take on a dangerous mission: destroy the reactors. He has little choice — the scientists are his only connection to Vurs and can reveal his location if he refuses.

Alone, he sets out across the ruined world, exploring abandoned places, uncovering traces of the past, and encountering people he once trusted.
summary:
The game takes place in 2009-2011.

Call of Blood is a cinematic single-player first-person shooter that immerses you in a gritty survival experience. The world is engulfed in a zombie outbreak, but the walking dead are far from your only problem.

You became the most wanted target after eliminating an influential politician who launched three dangerous reactors that could kill half of humanity.

Now, regular groups of enemies and elite operatives from the (Vurs) are hunting your head. A group of scientists is the only key to salvation. They offer you the dangerous deal of a lifetime: break through the cordon and blow up the sinister reactors from the inside.
